data.title: Child supplement application rejected
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte rejected David Muster's application of 6 October 2025 for child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for October 2025 to March 2026. The household income is above the maximum income limit.
data.explanation: Your application for child supplement was rejected because the income of your household is above the maximum income limit. The calculation is in an attachment that is not part of this text. You may decide to file an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree, in writing, electronically or in person for the record at the Familienkasse. The app shows until when you can do this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. Consider getting advice if you think the calculation is wrong.
